sources.quote: During 2022, 47,000 Medicare Part D enrollees received etanercept primarily for rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, or psoriatic arthritis. Total gross Medicare Part D spending on etanercept was $2.7 billion
sources.searcher_note: Same drug, same year, same measure (Part D gross spending 2022): $2.7B vs the lead's $2.27B. Also says two FDA-approved etanercept biosimilars are legally blocked until 2028 and 2029.

sources.quote: In doing so, Amgen successfully thwarted competition from two potential biosimilar competitors, Erelzi and Eticovo, which received FDA approval in 2016 and 2019, respectively.
sources.searcher_note: Names Enbrel, Erelzi and Eticovo; also estimates Medicare could have saved $1,053,023,122 in under four years without the patent extension.

sources.quote: But five years later, Erelzi still hasn't launched, even as 30 other biosimilars have won U.S. approval and 21 of them have reached market.
sources.searcher_note: Earliest coverage found of the approved-but-never-sold Enbrel copy; patent thicket story. No Medicare dollar figure.

sources.quote: Enbrel, a mainstay biologic in the inflammation category, fell 4% overall, with net selling price down 22%.
sources.searcher_note: Post-cutoff Enbrel coverage (Amgen Q2 2026 results, IRA Medicare price). Different finding; does not discuss the unsold copies or 2022 Part D cost.

notes: The never-launched Erelzi/Eticovo story is widely covered since 2021 (patent injunctions to April 2029). On the dollar figure: the only 2022 Part D gross spending number found is $2.7B (Arthritis & Rheumatology 2025), about 19% above the lead's $2.27B (the lead's sum comes from the per-prescriber file). CMS negotiation fact sheets report Enbrel for June 2022-May 2023, not calendar 2022; the CMS PDF could not be parsed by the fetch tool, so no quote. A search snippet cited a CMS figure of about $2.8B for Enbrel June 2022-May 2023; not recorded without a verified quote. Sandoz antitrust suit to launch Erelzi was dismissed Feb 2026 and is on appeal (IPWatchdog 2026-07-09, no quotable sentence on launch status).
